sloka: अयम् सुर पते घोरो विश्वामित्रो महामुनिः ।क्रोधम् उत्स्रच्यते घोरम् मयि देव न संशयः ॥१-६४-३॥
transliteration: ayam sura pate ghoro viśvāmitro mahāmuniḥ ।krodham utsracyate ghoram mayi deva na saṁśayaḥ ॥1-64-3॥

translations.english: 'Lord of the devatas this mighty ascetic Viswamitra is a terrible person. He will ceratinly release on his dreadful anger (curse me). O Lord this is my apprehension. You should excuse me'.
